completeness.interpretation: The two nullable history fields are structurally absent for all 600 new-customer records and must not be coerced to zero.

supportingDataset.source: UCI Default of Credit Card Clients, dataset 350

boundaries: The primary file can support material-completeness checks, task routing, CNY display and two-actor workflow demonstrations.
It cannot establish document authenticity, creditworthiness, approval, rejection, credit limits, default probability or business outcomes.
No name, identity number, phone number, address or document image exists in the primary file.
The supporting UCI label default_next_month and sensitive attributes never enter individual workspace reasons or receipts.

findings.finding: applications.csv is deterministic synthetic operational data, not observed China credit operations.
findings.impact: Use it to teach material remediation and human controls only; do not report policy performance or business benefit.

findings.finding: case.csv contains a historical outcome label and sensitive attributes from a Taiwan research dataset.
findings.impact: Keep it outside the individual reviewer UI and use only for isolated offline method and bias teaching.

recommendedTests: applications.csv has 1200 rows, 19 columns and 1200 unique application_id values
the featured application remains income-missing while identity, consent and consistency are confirmed
only source-record missing materials can enter a supplementation request
events and restored tasks are isolated by application objectId
case.csv and its future outcome or sensitive fields never enter the individual workspace
